items.title: William "Big Bill" Thompson Interview, 1961-03-01
items.q: The interviewee discusses 'Walter' (Walter Pichon) and 'Middle Kato' is mentioned by the interviewer as a potential alias or relation, but the interviewee never confirms a personal interaction with 'Middle Kato' specifically, nor does he identify Walter as Middle Kato in a way that establishes a dir

ctx.x: Well, they'd be happy with Hollywood's the best and who ain't. Everybody, let me tell you we play the best, alright.
And Big Kato or Middle Kato, were they brothers or something?

Well, I'll tell you, I'll tell you, I had the biggest surprise of my time playing, the big surprise I had was one day I was, I passed one day up on Orleans Street. And at that time, I'd see the fellow because he was called Walter. And Walter used to be playing on the piano all the time. And I said, I got there and I said, well, he saw me, he said, Mr. Bill, he said, stop, he said, stop a minute, he said, yeah, I'm playing. He said, listen, let me play. He said, I'll play.
